cohort: Obstetric patients admitted to the ICU of a Southeast Nigerian hospital between January 1, 2012, and December 31, 2013 (n=89, 1.7% of deliveries).  Majority were primiparous and between 26-30 years old.
finding: Ruptured uterus was the most common indication for ICU admission (36%), and maternal unbooked status was significantly associated with maternal mortality (13.5%).
